title: A form field's placeholder and a template string a body script fills a hint from count as printed
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: An input or textarea placeholder prints its words; a languageString slot held as a whole string value by an inline body script is printed; an article slot with the same words, a head script and a script loaded by address are not.

tests: a form field prints its hint as its placeholder, and a template string a body script fills a hint from is printed
